items.title: Boynton Yards zoning text amendment (Section 8.4.12.e.ii)
items.summary: Public hearing on a zoning text change requested by Boynton Yards LandCo LLC and Windsor Place Owner LLC. Residents can attend the virtual joint Land Use Committee and Planning Board hearing to testify.

items.title: Zoning amendment on affordable dwelling units (Section 12.1.2)
items.summary: Public hearing on a resident-petitioned zoning change to the city's affordable housing unit rules. Residents can attend the virtual hearing to testify.

items.title: Zoning amendment on Zoning Board of Appeals rules (Section 15.7.2.d)
items.summary: Public hearing on a resident-petitioned zoning change to the Zoning Board of Appeals board rules. Residents can attend the virtual hearing to testify.

items.title: Zoning amendment on backyard cottages (Section 3.1.12)
items.summary: Public hearing on a resident-petitioned zoning change to the rules for backyard cottages. Residents can attend the virtual hearing to testify.

items.title: Second zoning amendment on backyard cottages (Section 3.1.12)
items.summary: Public hearing on a second resident-petitioned zoning change to the backyard cottage rules. Residents can attend the virtual hearing to testify.
